verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents a 'Secure Cloud' tier in which machines are verified to sit in datacenters rated TIER 2/3 or ISO 27001, and these offers are labeled in search. That covers the datacenter-tier part of the story, but the pack contains no SOC 2 attestation or data-handling documentation. A community report of a host misrepresenting its location lowers confidence in listing accuracy but does not contradict the datacenter verification claim. Missing for 10: SOC 2 report or attestation, data handling/privacy documentation for proprietary models, a trust or compliance portal, independent corroboration of datacenter verification.
